1.title: A Shadowy Pursuit
1.introText: Steps echo through labyrinthine streets. A mysterious silhouette closes in on our thinky hero as they dash away.
1.winText: Our hero narrowly escapes, only to be surprised by a loud noise…

2.title: An Alarming Sound
2.introText: *Riiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiing* The whole bed seems to leap into the air. Phew, it was just a dream! Now how to turn this thing off?
2.winText: The alarm clock is finally silent. Wait, did our friend just press the snooze button?

3.title: The Perfect Slippers
3.introText: The perfect day starts with the perfect slippers, and our thinky friend, of course, has an overly elaborate method for picking them.
3.winText: Now that they have comfy feet, it’s time for breakfast.

4.title: Better Latte Than Never!
4.introText: Not even the perfect slippers can save the day from a broken coffee machine. Maybe pressing the right buttons will fix it?
4.winText: Our hero isn't aware yet, but they have a big adventure ahead.

5.title: The Newspaper Puzzle
5.introText: As if the day weren't puzzly enough already, it's time to check out the puzzles in today's paper!
5.winText: After such a nice thinky treat to start the day, it’s time to get freshened up.

6.title: The Leaky Pipes
6.introText: *drip* *drip* Fear not! Just another plumbing puzzle to crack.
6.winText: Ahh, nothing like a shower with good water pressure. But this peaceful relaxation won’t last for long…

7.title: Slippery Steps
7.introText: Oh, was that the doorbell? Can our puzzle pal spot the wet tiles and make their way to the door?
7.winText: After some careful tip-toeing, our friend finds something mysterious waiting at the door.

8.title: A Strange Package
8.introText: The mysterious parcel contains an odd-looking box with an even odder looking lock.
8.winText: With a clunk, the box falls apart, revealing a scrawled message: ‘We are the Solvers. Find us.’

9.title: This Way or That Way?
9.introText:
Who are these 

Solvers

? Someone in town will surely know, but… which way is that again?
9.winText: As our hero hikes the country trails, they notice a farm just over the next hill.

10.title: Herding the Sheep
10.introText: The local farmer spots our thinky friend and asks a quick favor: can you build a new enclosure for their puzzle-loving sheep?
10.winText: Whew, a job well done. But of course, it’s never just one favor!

11.title: The Graze Escape
11.introText: A sheep has gone missing! Can we work out which pastures it stopped in for a tasty snack?
11.winText:
The trail leads to a hidden clearing, where a 

very

 happy sheep lays amongst the half-chomped clover.

12.title: A Distracting Tree
12.introText: Unfortunately, our overfed sheep is distracted by a puzzling tree and won't budge until it's solved!
12.winText: Finally satisfied with both stomach food and brain food, our woolly friend is happy to get moving.

13.title: A Fluffy Problem
13.introText: Here's your lost sheep! Oh, now they need shearing? 5 sheep pens, each with 5 sheep - but in what order?
13.winText: With the fluffiness under control, it's time for our friend to continue their quest... right!?

14.title: One More Thing!
14.introText: Of course, as our thinky friend walks away, the farmer has yet another favor to ask. How will they break free from this infinite loop?
14.winText: A quick comment about how late it is, a few long strides, and the wave of a hand. It never fails.

15.title: Of Books and Shelves
15.introText:
At the local library, our hero scours through dusty books in search of clues about the Solvers, but no luck. A librarian must be 

somewhere 

in this maze of bookshelves.
15.winText: *CLUNK* *CLATTER* One small misstep and books fly everywhere. A stern "Shhh" is heard from behind the shelves.

16.title: Finding the Right Books
16.introText: After studying the note for a moment, the librarian points towards a towering bookshelf. Can our friend locate the right books?
16.winText: Huh, one of the books is missing! Perhaps the librarian knows who borrowed it.

17.title: The Library Records
17.introText: As the librarian scours through reams of records, our hero spots a puzzle etched into the front desk.
17.winText: Wow, they found a lead on the book borrower already? Time flies when you're solving puzzles!

18.title: That's Quite a Crowd
18.introText: Outside the library, our hero finds themselves blocked by a bustling crowd. Oh, it's the annual puzzle parade!
18.winText: After gently nudging their way past parade-goers, our friend is relieved to finally have some space to think.

19.title: A Grumpy Welcome
19.introText: At the book borrower's home, the welcome is all grumbles. Puzzles this, puzzles that, hmph! Wait, isn't that a puzzle right there?
19.winText: Our friend's puzzle-solving daydream is suddenly interrupted by a loud yelp!

20.title: Puzzlephobic
20.introText: A frightened book borrower slumps to the ground, hands over their eye, as a sheet of paper floats to the ground. A puzzle!
20.winText:
The puzzle (solved, of course) is quickly hurled away. Relieved, the borrower introduces themselves as Greg. What's 

your

 name?

21.title: The Chronicle
21.introText: Still grumpy but now grateful, the borrower shares their book: the town's chronicle. It contains only a brief mention of the Solvers, but a curious symbol appears beside it.
21.winText: Aha, it's the family crest of the local lockmaker. A new clue! We know what to do!

22.title: A Good Citizen
22.introText: Before continuing an adventure, a good citizen always returns their library books. Now, where was that shelf again?
22.winText: Feels good to do good! And luckily enough, the lockmaker lives not too far from here.

23.title: An Expected Lock
23.introText: As one might expect, the lockmaker's door is locked, and they're certainly known for making unusual locks!
23.winText: Don't worry, the lockmaker is always delighted when someone solves their locks!

24.title: Testing a New Model
24.introText: An excited lockmaker greets our friend, eagerly sharing their new puzzle lock designs: no keys, more fun! (Security? What's that?)
24.winText: They scribble down some potential improvements - the perfect moment to enquire about the Solvers!

25.title: Information Has a Price
25.introText: The Solvers? Sure, the lockmaker can help! What about this new lock over here though?
25.winText: Just as one lock opens, another lock is heard slamming shut with a loud clunk.

26.title: Locked In
26.introText: Our hero peers over at the cupboard door, from which sounds of discomfort can be heard. Has the lockmaker locked themself in?
26.winText: A flustered lockmaker, along with many brooms and buckets, spills out onto the floor.

27.title: A Key Clue
27.introText: The lockmaker, remaining ever evasive about the Solvers, relunctantly agrees to offer a tiny clue if the questions will stop.
27.winText: Wait, isn't that the book borrower's name?

28.title: Déjà Vu
28.introText: On the way back to Greg's house, as our hero admires the sights and sounds of the parade, an uneasy feeling sets in. Are we being followed?
28.winText: Huh, what was that? A shadow seems to dart around the corner.

29.title: A Blurry Figure
29.introText: Our hero squints over their shoulder, trying to make out a mysterious silhouette amongst the crowds.
29.winText: Ugh, no luck! They vanished! However, there are more urgent matters - this mystery will have to wait.

30.title: Stepping on a Puzzle
30.introText: Back at Greg's house, where the grumbles continue, our hero scouts every inch for clues. Isn't it weird that these floor tiles are numbered?
30.winText: No, not a clue! Just a fun hidden puzzle. What else do we have around here?

31.title: The Evidence
31.introText: Our enthusiastic friend, always ready to crack a case, starts tagging everything with numbers as if it were a crime scene.
31.winText: You know, Greg might not appreciate it, but this place is packed with puzzle potential!

32.title: Digging for Clues
32.introText: Greg, tired of these antics, suggests our hero should look for clues in the garden. Big mistake! There's a shovel!
32.winText: Several holes later and still no clues, but plenty of mess!

33.title: Yet More Digging
33.introText: Shocked by the destruction, Greg insists on moving elsewhere, perhaps over that nearby hill. A hill? Something else to dig!
33.winText: This hill is starting to look like Swiss cheese! But when our thinky hero is on a mission...

34.title: The Excavation
34.introText: Never one to give up, our friend sets up an amateurish, yet entirely serious, archeological excavation.
34.winText: *CLUNK* The shovel strikes something metallic. What could it be?

35.title: The Buried Chest
35.introText: It's a chest! Brute force might have found it, but it certainly won't get us past this unusual lock.
35.winText: Eh, a few gold coins, who needs those? More importantly, a mysterious photo! Wait, is that...

36.title: Kicked Out
36.introText: Greg is certainly not pleased with the discovery! Kicked off the premises, our rejected friend goes for a wander around the block.
36.winText: Just about to find something new to do, our thinky pal overhears the faint sound of sniffling.

37.title: Taking a Closer Look
37.introText: A tearful Greg tells of an estranged friend, a puzzle-solving buddy from years gone by. Fading memories, just like this photograph.
37.winText: Through the tears, there's the faint glimmer of happy memories. Perhaps it's time to reconnect?

38.title: To the Library!
38.introText: When in need of answers, always go to your local library! But where's that librarian hiding again?
38.winText: The librarian recalls the two (very noisy) friends all too well. Surely we can find who you're looking for.

39.title: Locating a Lost Friend
39.introText: A dark and musty room full of annuaries, address books, and town records. We'll need one from each section, but can we find them?
39.winText: The bad news: Greg's long lost friend has moved far away. The good news: we know where!

40.title: Déjàdéjà Vu
40.introText: As they set off from the library, our hero gets that uneasy feeling again. Just as a precaution, they take an odd path back to Greg's house.
40.winText: Unfamiliar streets, unfamiliar buildings, and there's not a soul in sight... oh no, we're lost!

41.title: Who Goes There?
41.introText: What was that shadow in the corner of our hero's eye? Just a friendly passerby?
41.winText: Squinting into the distance reveals it's just the farmer. Quickly! Or they'll request more favours!

42.title: Catching Your Breath
42.introText: Finally back at Greg's house, our hero, catching their breath, struggles to get the words out. F... F... FR...
42.winText: Greg's usual frown turns to great excitement upon hearing the news. Let's write a letter!

43.title: The Right Puzzle
43.introText: Of course, a letter to an old friend should always include a fun puzzle. What about this one?
43.winText: Hm, it's a great puzzle, but maybe too on the nose! What about...

44.title: Maybe This One?
44.introText: Greg mutters to themself as they discard puzzle after puzzle. Their eye sets on a new one. What about this?
44.winText: Ah, an oldie but goodie. In the blink of an eye, Greg reappears, envelope stamped and sealed.

45.title: An Important Delivery
45.introText: So eager to catch up on years of missed puzzles, Greg dashes away, leaving our hero to find the way through town to send the letter.
45.winText: After an undisturbed stroll, they arrive at the most reliable delivery service: the local pigeon fancier.

46.title: You've Got Mail
46.introText: Pigeons are, of course, the most popular delivery service for puzzle fans. Now, how to convey an address to them?
46.winText: With that, one of the pigeons takes the letter in its beak and flaps away. Goodbye, feathered friend!

47.title: Street Puzzles
47.introText: Another good deed done! Though not much progress on the Solvers. Wait, is that graffiti a puzzle?
47.winText: How curious! It seems to suggest a direction. How could one not follow a clue like this?

48.title: One Leads to Another
48.introText: The trail leads to more graffiti - this one, tagged by the Solvers. What an unorthodox way to publish puzzles!
48.winText: Each mysterious sign points to another, leading finally to the old clock tower at the centre of town.

49.title: The Old Clock Tower
49.introText: At the clock tower, an arrow points inside. Beside it, there's another puzzle with a note: "This one's just for fun".
49.winText: A fun puzzle indeed! Our hero ventures into the old building to see what else awaits them.

50.title: Up We Go
50.introText: Up a maze of rickety stairs we climb, through dark and narrow doorways. People rarely wander around here.
50.winText: Just as our hero suspects the climb might never end, they stumble into a brightly lit room.

51.title: Almost There!
51.introText: We must be near the top now! In front of an elaborately locked door, we find a table with an intriguing puzzle laid upon it.
51.winText: After a series of heavy clunks, the wind howls through the door as it slowly opens.

52.title: Bird's-Eye View
52.introText: We're so high up! That's our house over there! Wait, are the buildings below trying to tell us something?
52.winText: Wow, those buildings point towards a small neighbourhood over there! Who prepared all this!?

53.title: A Baa-rricade
53.introText: Leaving the tower, our friend stumbles upon a familiar flock of sheep blocking the street, mesmerised by a puzzle!
53.winText: Satisfied with the solve, the sheep shuffle to the side, revealing... Oh no, the farmer!

54.title: Not Again!
54.introText: Before we can escape, the farmer sprints forward, requesting help with a particularly confounding puzzle (or so they say).
54.winText: The farmer seems to have a lot to say about this puzzle! Back away... slowly...

55.title: A Slow Getaway
55.introText: Our hero steps back, but the farmer approaches again, another puzzle in hand. To onlookers, it seems like an absurdly slow chase!
55.winText: As they finally make their escape, they could have sworn the farmer signalled to someone else.

56.title: The Latest Version
56.introText:
Just a few steps away from the farmer, the lockmaker suddenly appears with a fancy new lock. Apparently we simply 

must 

try this latest version!
56.winText: Well, sure, that was a pretty nice lock... but how did the lockmaker suddenly get here?

57.title: No More Interruptions
57.introText: That's enough! Time to get out of here! But how do these narrow alleys weave between the buildings?
57.winText: Well, this is the neighbourhood we saw from the clocktower... but what now?

58.title: Making Art
58.introText: Beside some suspiciously grid-like wall markings, our friend finds an unused spray can with a note: "Use this!"
58.winText: Oh wow, a hidden number! Perhaps there's a door around here with that number?

59.title: A Meandering Path
59.introText: From behind door 23, a booming (yet oddly familiar) voice emanates: Recall the path you have taken. Apply one step at a time.
59.winText: A second, meek voice chimes in, asking if our hero brought cookies, then a chorus of grumbling stomachs.

60.title: A Sweet Treat
60.introText: If the Solvers need cookies, they need cookies! This bakery is like a maze, but their favourite treat must be in here somewhere.
60.winText: Aha, here they are! Hm, didn't we see these cookies somewhere before?

61.title: The Final Riddle
61.introText: The now appreciative voice speaks again: What is our sigil? Since the clocktower, it has been nearby. Recall the puzzles you have solved. Follow the cookie crumbs.
61.winText: The door opens slowly (dramatic tension!) to reveal a few friendly faces: Welcome, Solver! We have cookies!

1.title: Making a Connection
1.introText: Cookie in hand, our hero is bundled inside the building. The welcome is warm but confusing, so let's take a moment to connect the dots.
1.winText: As we descend a long stone staircase, they explain the Solvers are dedicated to puzzles and mysteries. Well duh!

2.title: From Far Away
2.introText: The trio pauses to inspect a puzzle. It's been sent in by a fellow Solver, the lockmaker explains. This one's come a long way!
2.winText: Our hero could make discoveries like this, the farmer says. Just as soon as they pass their apprenticeship!

3.title: How Big is this Place?
3.introText: The trio strolls through room after room, chatting happily as our pal puffs along behind, trying to keep track of the underground sprawl.
3.winText: The group draws to a halt at the largest rectan...er... room. It appears to be some kind of grand hall...

4.title: A Cryptic Crest
4.introText: As the lockmaker begins to recite the legend of the Seven Founding Solvers, our hero raises their hand. What's going on with that shield?
4.winText: Our friend nods happily - that was fun! But the Solvers are exchanging meaningful glances. How odd.

5.title: What's In Here?
5.introText: While the Solvers huddle up, talking in low voices, our hero begins to wander. In a cluttered side room, a piece of wall art catches their eye.
5.winText: A burst of chatter breaks the silence. Behind a wall of knick-knacks is a ragtag group. Are they Solvers too?

6.title: A Meeting of Minds
6.introText: The strangers pause mid-chat. There's a wary silence, then one gives our hero a friendly wave. They seem to be working on a puzzle!
6.winText: After a round of high-twos, the group introduces itself properly. These are the other apprentices!

7.title: A Rival Arises
7.introText: One apprentice is less friendly. They glare at our inquisitive pal, fold their arms, and issue a challenge. If you're so smart, show us your best puzzle.
7.winText: The apprentice answers correctly and smirks, claiming the puzzle was easy peasy. It seems our hero has a rival.

8.title: Challenge Accepted
8.introText: The rival informs the group that nobody cool is solving Even/Odd Sudoku anymore. The hot new thing is Parity Partitions! Here's one of mine...
8.winText: As the rival huffs at our friend's speedy solution, a Senior Solver appears. Everyone to the hall, please!

9.title: Getting A Mentor
9.introText: The grand hall now contains a selection of puzzles and the Solvers who created them. Solve a puzzle, and its setter becomes your mentor.
9.winText: Our thinky friend has attracted a mentor! She beams with satisfaction and beckons them to follow her.

10.title: Wait For Me!
10.introText: Mentor and mentee head deeper into the tangle of rooms. It's a struggle to keep pace, and our friend is forced to stop to get their bearings.
10.winText: Our friend gasps. Instead of an office, they arrive in a cavernous room covered with intricate mosaics.

11.title: Telling Tiles
11.introText: Mosaics, it seems, are this mentor's specialist subject. Her eye lights up as she brandishes a tiny tile. Even the smallest are vital to the whole picture!
11.winText: She watches appreciatively as our hero handles the tiles with care. This is one of the Solvers' oldest patterns.

12.title: To The Workshop!
12.introText: The mentor appraises our friend. They'll need a toolkit, but there's a spare in the workshop. Come back when you have it!
12.winText: Our hero finds themself back in the now-empty grand hall. They could swear these passages have shifted!

13.title: A Guiding Hum
13.introText: A distant humming echoes from above. These stairs are in need of better lighting, but perhaps the hummer up there knows the way to the workshop?
13.winText: Emerging from the newly lit spiral staircase, our hero manages to startle the Solvers' happily humming janitor.

14.title: The Helpful Janitor
14.introText: Once they regain their composure, the janitor is only too happy to help our friend. This simple riddle should take them right to the workshop door.
14.winText: Our hero calls out their thanks and rushes off towards the workshop as the janitor resumes their cheery tune.

15.title: A Messy Workshop
15.introText: The workshop is a total mess! Our hero's mentor might be a genius, but she doesn't seem to believe in putting things back in the right places.
15.winText: Hmm. Our puzzle-loving pal has tidied up all the tools in the workshop, so why does the kit have all these gaps?

16.title: Tracking the Tools
16.introText: Missing tools AND mucky footprints? Our thinky chum is in their element as they grab a torch and follow the splotches down the hallway.
16.winText: The tracks lead into a busy cafeteria where the janitor is carefully mopping the dirty floor. Our hero must hurry!

17.title: Where Did You Find That?
17.introText: The last of the footprints take our pal to a flock of familiar faces. Who brought the sheep to the cafeteria? And where did they get that puzzle?!
17.winText: The sheep baa happily at the solution, then CLANG! Lightly chewed tools lie at the feet of a guilty-looking sheep.

18.title: A Handy Distraction
18.introText: As our hero gathers the tools, the farmer runs over, waving a puzzle. They seem keen to avoid the janitor's pointed questions about sheep with muddy feet...
18.winText: The sheep are enthralled, and crowd round our hero to look at the solution. They like you, says the farmer fondly.

19.title: The Practice Pen
19.introText: My hobby is decryptozoology, the farmer explains. It means I train these beauties to sniff out puzzles. Here's a picture of one from their training pen.
19.winText: Our hero looks up to find the flock heading for the door. It's time to see these woolly wonders in action!

20.title: Pathfinding For Puzzles
20.introText: As our hero watches the flock, the farmer points out how different sheep are attracted to the traces of different types of puzzle. Look at 'em go!
20.winText: As they pass the workshop, our friend bids the farmer farewell. Time to finish that toolkit and find the mentor!

21.title: Nothing To See Here
21.introText: Next, our thinky friend must find their mentor. Alas! They meet their rival instead. The rival turns away, trying to hide a puzzle from view...
21.winText: Oh! The rival is trying to hide the fact their solution contains an error. Should our hero offer a helping hand?

22.title: Something Similar
22.introText: A direct offer of help seems risky. Instead, our hero pretends to be stuck on a similar puzzle. Would the rival mind checking their solution?
22.winText: The rival eyes their own puzzle, now able to spot the error, then hurries off, gabbling something about vital work...

23.title: Navigating the Department
23.introText: Our friend manages to retrace their steps as far as the mosaic department, but where was the mentor's cavernous room?
23.winText: Our friend enters the elaborately tiled space, and the mentor rushes over. Where have you been?!

24.title: A Mythic Mosaic
24.introText: Our hero holds up their toolkit, but the mentor bats it aside and runs to an ancient section of wall. Do these figures seem connected to you?
24.winText: A tiled inscription reads: "Our Eight Founding Solvers". Eight? The lockmaker definitely said seven!

25.title: The Archiving System
25.introText: In search of information, the mentor sends our hero to the Solver archives. It seems her memory of the classification system is... incomplete.
25.winText: Our friend scoops up the books, pauses, writes a note to explain the "loan" to any irate archivists, and leaves.

26.title: Stray Puzzles
26.introText: Our friend spies the janitor picking puzzle papers off the floor ahead. They stop to help, but are soon distracted by an enticing problem.
26.winText: Solvers throw their papers in the air to celebrate a solution, says the janitor. I collect them for my teabreaks!

27.title: A Puzzle Break
27.introText: A break sounds like a great idea to our thinky pal, so they huddle up to chat with the Janitor as they work on a puzzle together.
27.winText: The pair's chatter turns to the subject of the Founding Solvers. The janitor looks thoughtful.

28.title: The Way to the Old Wing
28.introText: I don't know if it's what you're after, says the janitor, but all the unsorted documents go into the Odds and Ends room in the Old Wing.
28.winText: Our hero eyes the books from the archive. The Old Wing will be the next port of call if these don't help.

29.title: A Cry in the Dark
29.introText: Our friend is about to open the first book when a sob echoes through the air vents. They peek into a darkened doorway. Is someone crying in there?
29.winText: Padding into a gloomy bathroom, our protagonist spots an even gloomier sight, curled up under a sink.

30.title: Getting Unstuck
30.introText: It's one of the other would-be Solvers. They hold out a tear-stained problem page, and explain their predicament between gasps. I got s-s-stuck!
30.winText: Our friend holds the soggy paper under a hand dryer, then the pair looks over the solution together.

31.title: The Anxious Mouse
31.introText: Between sniffles we learn that this is Mouse. They love puzzles, but get so anxious under pressure. Our pal offers to help with another practice puzzle.
31.winText: Watching Mouse work, our hero realises that they are very clever; they just struggle to focus when anxious.

32.title: A Secret Meeting
32.introText: As thanks for our hero's help, Mouse shyly invites them to a secret meeting. Intriguing! But they'll need to decipher Mouse's directions...
32.winText: The note finally leads the duo to a nondescript door. Mouse gives a timid knock. Hello?

33.title: Entry Requirements
33.introText: A voice comes from behind the peephole. You know the rules, Mouse! No newbies unless they can solve a most illuminating riddle!
33.winText: The door swings open to reveal the lively clamour of a party. The cheering is particularly loud in one corner.

34.title: Speedy Solvers
34.introText: It's a speed-solving party! Our thinky friend isn't too fussed about the timer, but the puzzle tables and the lively mood are impossible to resist!
34.winText: Mouse cheers, but a loud scoff lets our hero know someone beat them. It's the Rival. And they're smirking!

35.title: Quick on the Uptake
35.introText: The Rival starts bragging about their solve times, but our thinky pal is barely listening. They're far more interested in another puzzle!
35.winText: Our hero watches an expert solve the same puzzle in seconds. It's tempting to stay, but the archive books are calling.

36.title: A Riveting Read
36.introText: Finally, our hero finds a quiet spot and curls up with the books. No more distractio- Oooh! There's a puzzle in this one!
36.winText: Our friend tries again to focus, but the accounts just don't seem to line up. It's like something's missing.

37.title: Founders Not Found
37.introText: Our hero begins to leaf through the images. This one maps part of the labyrinthine Solver building, but the details are so faded.
37.winText: Why is it so hard to find out about the founders? Our friend sighs and closes the book, just as their mentor arrives.

38.title: A Solo Quest
38.introText: The mentor is seeking would-be Solvers. It's time for individual puzzle quests, so you all need starter puzzles, she says. I think this is yours!
38.winText: A tree? Is there a garden down here? Our hero sets their "borrowed" books aside and goes in search of greenery.

39.title: Branching Off
39.introText: No trees so far, thinks our pal. Not a single root or branch. Wait! Roots and branches, roots and- Routes and branches! I need a tree-shaped path!
39.winText: Our thinky pal gasps; one of the halls contains a small meadow??? There must be a botanist in the Solvers!

40.title: Puzzling Petals
40.introText: Our friend steps onto the grass, crouching to admire the flowers. It looks like they're being bred for their puzzle patterns. Look at this one!
40.winText: Our pal is reluctant to leave, but the flowers must be part of the quest. Does the archive have botany books?

41.title: Directions for Mouse
41.introText: On the way to the archive, our pal bumps into a cheery Mouse. Their quest is going great! But, um, would our hero double-check this answer?
41.winText: Our hero nods. The route is correct! They tactfully turn Mouse to face the right direction and wish them luck!

42.title: Locked Out
42.introText: The archive is locked! It seems that folks have been taking books and leaving notes in their place. Oops! The lock doesn't seem too tricky, though...
42.winText: There's a satisfying click, and the door swings open. Our hero hurries in and begins to scan the shelves.

43.title: Strange Horticulture
43.introText: The botany section is tightly packed. Our pal manages to free a volume on breeding puzzle plants, but its author is mainly interested in tomatoes!
43.winText: Our thinky friend tries to replace the book, but it's impossible to squeeze it back into the over-stuffed shelf.

44.title: The Missing Book
44.introText: Our thinky pal scans the shelf, finally spotting a handy gap. But a handy gap means a missing book! Our friend examines the shelf more closely...
44.winText: What are you doing here? asks the janitor. Between you and that Rival, we won't have any books left!

45.title: Hot On The Trail
45.introText: It seems the Rival "borrowed" a book on puzzle flowers. They didn't even leave a note! Our pal must play detective and work out where they've got to...
45.winText: Our hero takes a deep breath and opens the door. The Rival is waiting, and they do not seem happy!

46.title: The Mix-Up
46.introText: There's a mix-up, rants the Rival. My mentor studies flowers - I even got their book - but I keep getting mosaics! We're swapping back. THIS is yours.
46.winText: The shapes match the stone slabs in one corner. As the Rival flounces off, our pal bends down. A slab has come loose!

47.title: Some Assembly Required
47.introText: Our thinky friend lifts the slab. There's a little hidey-hole underneath, containing a partial mosaic and a handful of tiles. This is more like it!
47.winText: Café? Oh! The cafeteria! At least our thinky pal knows where they're going for the next puzzle. Probably.

48.title: A Wrong Turn (Or Two)
48.introText: Many wrong turns later, our confident hero arrives not at the cafeteria, but the Old Wing. Oh, well! At least they can search for that Odds and Ends room.
48.winText: Our pal picks their way through the dusty clutter, trying not to disturb anything wriggly or cobwebby.

49.title: Strange Antiquities
49.introText: Our dusty hero enters a room heaving with unlabeled junk. This is it! They pick up an old photo album, scanning for the original Solvers.
49.winText: Hmm, nothing in this one except startling retro fashion! Perhaps there's something further down the pile?

50.title: Cropped Out
50.introText: The album at the bottom of the pile looks ancient. Our hero spots a group picture with... seven people? They squint, trying to make out the details.
50.winText: Hah! An eighth member has been cut out on one side! Were they written out of the confusing archive book too?

51.title: A Little Break
51.introText: The same seven Solvers appear over and over. Empty spaces show where the eighth has likely been cut out. Ugh! Our pal needs a puzzle break!
51.winText: Feeling calmer, our friend returns to the Solver conundrum. It seems pretty extreme to cut someone out like this!

52.title: A Faded Floorplan
52.introText: Poking around behind the boxes, our friend finds some yellowing scrolls. This one might be a blueprint, but the ink has faded. Where are the walls?!
52.winText: It seems to show part of the Old Wing, but there are no helpful clues, like people's names on the rooms. Drat!

53.title: Tracing the Timeline
53.introText: As our hero sifts through the rest of the paper, they begin to construct a basic timeline of early Solver events. What a curious history!
53.winText: These Solvers seem to keep hold of everything EXCEPT details of this eighth member. It's infuriating!

54.title: Seating Plan
54.introText: Is this a seating chart from a Solver dinner? Our thinky friend turns the chart this way and that, trying to make sense of the shape of the table.
54.winText: Our hero wonders how the Solvers got furniture like that through the door, let alone down these corridors!

55.title: Breaking and Exiting
55.introText: Our pal stretches. They should solve the mentor's quest before tackling the rest of the documents. Time to leave and- uh-oh! Who locked the door?!
55.winText: No sooner has our friend left the Odds and Ends room than another question arises: who turned out the lights?

56.title: Feeling the Way
56.introText: The Old Wing is now pitch dark. Our pal puts a hand on the wall, keeping their panic at bay by feeling around to find the way out.
56.winText: Our uneasy friend follows the wall along a hallway, but finds only a dead end. Is it time to panic yet?

57.title: A Glimmer Of Light
57.introText: Taking a deep breath, our hero realises they can make out a soft glow near the floor. Emergency lights! They must lead to the exit!
57.winText: Nearing the exit, our pal hears familiar humming! They call out, and a horrified janitor rushes to unlock the door.

58.title: An Apology Puzzle
58.introText: The janitor had no idea anyone was here! Apologising profusely to our shaken hero, they offer them a calming puzzle.
58.winText: Our friend feels better now, but the janitor walks them to the cafeteria anyway. Better safe than sorry!

59.title: Is This It?
59.introText: A huge mosaic has been wheeled into the cafeteria. The hero is definitely following the right quest now! So, what does it say?
59.winText: The solution has the feeling of a grand reveal, but embark on what? To where? They need to find the mentor...

60.title: Marvellous Mouse!
60.introText: Our baffled friend steps back, bumping into a jubilant Mouse. They finally finished their quest! Look! This was the last puzzle.
60.winText: Well done, Mouse! Our pal gives them a high two, then heads to the mentor's office. Time for some answers!

61.title: A Transformative Finale
61.introText: The mentor has the final clue! She welcomes our pal, then recites, "Puzzles NOT EMBLEMATIC of the Solvers, will act as vital info holders!"
61.winText: Spot on! Pack some warm clothes and meet me at the Solvers' mountain outpost! Your apprenticeship project awaits!

1.title: The Journey Begins
1.introText: Our hero arrives at the train station, ready for their snowy adventure! Their first challenge? Navigating the queue for the ticket office...
1.winText: As our thinky pal arrives on the platform, a familiar face catches their eye. What a nice surprise!

2.title: Mouse On Tour
2.introText: Mouse waves so enthusiastically that their bulging suitcase goes flying! It pings open, and our pal rushes to help Mouse repack their belongings.
2.winText: As the case clicks shut, our hero spots an address label. Mouse is off to the city for their mentor's project.

3.title: Just In Case
3.introText: The friends bundle onto the train, only to find spilt coffee in the luggage rack! Can our hero arrange the suitcases so nothing gets wet?
3.winText: Cases safely stowed, our hero turns to look for a seat. There's one left, and it's next to a very unfriendly face!

4.title: You Again!
4.introText: Our hero slides into the seat, hoping for quiet. Alas, the Rival is in a very chatty mood, and our pal has to concentrate to follow all the bragging!
4.winText: As our pal listens, they realise the brags hide the fact the Rival appears to be off to petsit for their mentor.

5.title: A Ticket To Ride
5.introText: "All tickets, please!" calls the train manager. But when they reach our hero, they frown. "This ticket's missing a number! No number, no travel..."
5.winText: "Perfect," says the inspector. They move on to the Rival's ticket. "Lovely. And we're just arriving at your stop!"

6.title: A Very Mouse-y Map
6.introText: As the Rival leaves, Mouse slips into their seat. "I have to get a bus next, but my map only has the stations, not the route! How will I know where to hop off?"
6.winText: "Oooh!" says Mouse. "This bit goes right by the newspaper!" Mouse's project is at the Thinky Times? Impressive!

7.title: Paper Puzzles
7.introText: Mouse will be working on the newspaper's puzzle desk. They might even submit one of their own puzzles! What does our pal think of this one?
7.winText: Our thinky friend nods at the anxious Mouse. This would be perfect for the- WAIT! Isn't this Mouse's stop?

8.title: Is this in Celsius?
8.introText: Mouse scrambles off the train, and our hero settles in for the long ride to the mountains. An odd device tracks the falling temperature in the cabin.
8.winText: The multi-thermometer shows where the cabin gets coldest, so our hero makes sure to avoid those seats!

9.title: Loop-The-Loop
9.introText: As the landscape turns to snow, our shivering hero fetches a scarf from their case. It's been ages since they wore one. Was it over, then under...?
9.winText: By the time our hero is finished, they're all hot and bothered. This must be how scarves keep folk warm.

10.title: Clear As Mud
10.introText: Suddenly, the ancient tannoy crackles to life. "We**ill*be*call*ng*at*** ****in**f*ve*min*tes". Calling where? Is this our hero's station?
10.winText: That's our protagonist's stop! Thank goodness they managed to solve the tannoy message in time!

11.title: A Cautious Climb
11.introText: From the station, it's a steep, slippery hike to the Old Solver Lodge. Our hero studies the conductor's pocket guide, looking for a safe route.
11.winText: As our pal leaves, the conductor adds, "If in doubt, follow cold air for the Lodge, warm air for the town!"

12.title: Nearly There!
12.introText: On the final stretch of the slippery route, the sun on the snow becomes dazzling. Time to heed the conductor and follow the cold air for the Lodge!
12.winText: After a very cautious final ascent, our protagonist arrives! They shield their eye and try to make out the building...

13.title: A Dramatic Entrance
13.introText: Our pal thought the Mentor would pick a mosaic project, but they want to repair the Lodge. That door needs fixing... oooh! What are those symbols?
13.winText: The Founders built this place, but it's barely in the official Solver history. It reminds our pal of the Eighth Founder.

14.title: Hello, Darkness
14.introText: Our hero enters the Lodge and calls a greeting. No answer. And no working lights either. They sigh and begin to feel their way around the space.
14.winText: Just as our pal is getting the hang of the layout, a noise echoes through the dark. Were those footsteps?

15.title: An Old Fashioned Cuppa
15.introText: It's the Mentor! Thrusting a bucket at our pal, she leads the way to a kitchen. "Hello! We need water for tea. There's a well across the courtyard!"
15.winText: When our thinky waterbearer returns, the Mentor has a fire going in the grate. The Lodge is cosier already!

16.title: The Messy Mentor
16.introText: As the Mentor brews the tea, our friend notices her tools are already out and in total disarray. Might as well tidy them while the kettle boils.
16.winText: "This was a busy Solver outpost once," says the Mentor, pouring tea. "One legend says a Founder lived here. Imagine!"

17.title: Light Relief
17.introText: "RAAAAGH!" A terrifying yowl breaks the silence. "Just the wind," says the Mentor, but our pal is rattled. More candles will make this place less scary!
17.winText: See? The yowl was probably nothing... And what's this? Our pal's activity has knocked something out of the rafters.

18.title: The Mysterious Bag
18.introText: A moth-eaten bag dangles from a wooden beam. The yellowing paper shows signs of decay, but the puzzle still seems solvable.
18.winText: Why would a Solver keep a puzzle hidden? Our pal will ponder that later; right now, their stomach is rumbling!

19.title: The Uncooperative Stove
19.introText: The oven is as unresponsive as the lights, so our thinky chef must brave the Mentor's ancient portable stove and its unpredictable hot spots!
19.winText: Our pal scrapes off the burnt bits and dishes up. This will keep the tummy rumbling at bay until morning!

20.title: There's No "We" in "Mosaic"
20.introText: "You'll soon fix this place up!" says the Mentor. Surely she means "we"? "Nope! I'll be in the mosaic caves, just past the frozen path! I found this one earlier!"
20.winText: Hmm. Mosaic caves sound cool! But the Lodge had that hidden puzzle... Poking around might reveal more!

21.title: Solver Handicrafts
21.introText: As the pair clear up, our friend spots a pretty grid adorning the table. "How retro!" exclaims the Mentor. "We used these to hide messages when I was a girl."
21.winText: What a charming decoration. Our pal immediately starts imagining a set of matching coasters!

22.title: That's No Lullaby!
22.introText: Our pal is heading to bed when a fresh "RAAAGH!" shakes the walls. They grab extra pillows and bedding, then make a sleep cave to hide in.
22.winText: Inside the sleep cave, our thinky friend tries to relax. It's been a long day, and they're exhausted!

23.title: A Night On The Tiles
23.introText: Our jittery hero soothes themself to sleep by focusing on lovely, non-scary mosaics! In fact, they focus so hard that even their dreams involve mosaics!
23.winText: Waking up briefly, our friend wants to capture the puzzle. But there's no pen, and the sleep cave is so comfyzzzzz...

24.title: A Slippery Morning Walk
24.introText: Morning! Our hero heads to the kitchen. It's empty, as is the water bucket. Yawning, our pal crosses the new courtyard ice to reach the well.
24.winText: Our friend skids back to the kitchen and boils the trusty kettle. They'll need a cup of tea before getting started!

25.title: Penmanship Counts!
25.introText: The Mentor has already gone to the caves, leaving our pal a list of tasks for the Lodge. The first task will be deciphering the Mentor's scribbles.
25.winText: Relief washes over our pal as they finally make sense of the note. Time to get to work!

26.title: In a Dark Dark Room
26.introText: Our hero's first task is to restore electricity to the Lodge. There's a fuse box in the basement. The dark, dark basement...
26.winText: CLONK! Our friend's hand hits the fuse box while they're flailing at a cobweb. Thank goodness for that.

27.title: Under The Planks
27.introText: Electricity! Our pal does a celebratory jig aaaand... puts their foot through a rotten floorboard. Hmm. Probably best to check the size of that hole...
27.winText: It doesn't seem too big, although what's this? Our friend pulls out damp fungus and another mysterious bag.

28.title: Someone Else's Treasure
28.introText: The bag contains another scrap of yellowing paper. It has begun to sprout mushrooms in one corner, but our hero can still make out a puzzle.
28.winText: Our friend tries to imagine the kind of Solver who hides little path puzzles in bags. Perhaps it's part of a game?

29.title: It'll Probably Dry
29.introText: Next up? "Fix plumbing!" After a struggle with the water valve, our pal patrols the lodge. Several leaks are already producing ice patches.
29.winText: Our soggy pal sighs. The plumbing here is more like a nest made from metal tubes than a functional system!

30.title: A Plumbing Genius
30.introText: For each leak our hero fixes, more appear. It'd be easier to dismantle the whole thing and start from scratch. In fact, that's not such a bad idea...
30.winText: Our plumbing pal cautiously turns a tap on. Water flows into the sink and not onto the floor. SUCCESS!

31.title: Stubborn Herd
31.introText: Last task: "Evict the goats." Huh?! Our hero finds an entire herd in the dining room. They won't leave, so our pal tries to arrange them neatly instead.
31.winText: Our friend coaxes the last goat into place. It harrumphs, then swallows. Hey! Was that the task list?!

32.title: The Mentor Returns
32.introText: "I like what you've done with the goats," says the Mentor. She's back from the caves, holding a picture of a new mosaic. "Look what I found!"
32.winText: Yet another mosaic showing eight similar figures? Our hero squints. They look kind of like the Founders...

33.title: The Lodge Library
33.introText: A loud "RAAAAGH!" startles our hero. The Mentor insists it's the wind, but it sounded more like an animal. Perhaps there are books on local critters in the Lodge library?
33.winText: There's a whole shelf on local fauna, but it's the perfect height for local goats. Tattered pages are all that remain.

34.title: Lightly Chewed
34.introText: Behind the leftover literature, our hero spots a little hidey-hole. It contains another yellowing sheet of paper - only lightly nibbled, thank goodness!
34.winText: What an odd collection our friend is amassing. Best keep them out of reach of hungry creatures!

35.title: Goated
35.introText: After a little supper from the electric oven, our hero heads to bed. Stubborn goats haunt their dreams, each demanding to be rearranged.
35.winText: Finally, the dream goats are happy! Their leader nods at our hero and then begins to tap dance...

36.title: Special Delivery
36.introText: TAPPITY-TAP! Wha-? Oh! There's a delivery pigeon at the window. It's got a letter from Mouse, including their first published Thinky Times puzzle!
36.winText: That was great! And it sounds like Mouse is enjoying the paper. Our pal wonders what to say in reply.

37.title: Penpals
37.introText: Our hero pads downstairs for paper. They tell Mouse about the scary noise and the hidden puzzles, and sign off with a goat-inspired brainteaser.
37.winText: The pigeon accepts a little breakfast, then flies off with our pal's letter. Stay safe, feathery friend!

38.title: It's Cold Outside
38.introText: A thunderous "RAAAAGH!" spooks our pal. Time for a walk down the slope - the locals might know about the noise. If it's not too cold, that is.
38.winText: Our pal frowns, then checks the thermometer again. Gosh, that's cold! They'll need all their woollens for this walk!

39.title: Hitting the Slopes
39.introText: Our hero was dreading the journey to the tiny town, but some kind soul has marked a safe ski route down the slippery slopes. How neighbourly!
39.winText: Our friend decides to ask about the noise at the train station. There are bound to be one or two people there.

40.title: Perfect Timing
40.introText: "Can't talk!" yells the station manager. "I'm regrouting the welcome mosaic, and it's all gone wrong! If only a mosaic scholar would stop by..."
40.winText: Mosaic mended, our pal mentions the scary noise. "No idea," says the station manager. "I'd ask at the bookstore!"

41.title: A Little Treat
41.introText: The bookshop is just past a cocoa stand. A delicious-smelling cocoa stand... Our pal's tummy rumbles. Time for a little treat! But which one?
41.winText: A spicy aroma fills the air as the barista brews the custom order. Our friend takes a cautious sip. Heavenly!

42.title: Local Legends
42.introText:
Asking around at the bookshop, it seems the patrons know the noise 

and

 have theories on the culprit! One person even gets out a blurry photo.
42.winText: "That thing was huge," says the photo's owner. "Spooked me good and proper, I don't mind telling you!"

43.title: Surrounded By Wildlife
43.introText: Perhaps a creature in these books will match the blurry shape in that photo? Our hero makes a workspace amid the teetering piles of the wildlife section.
43.winText: There's no mention of the creature, but these are great books. Our pal orders one about goat-proofing for the Lodge.

44.title: Forgotten Deliveries
44.introText: "You're at Solver Lodge?" The bookseller pulls out a box of uncollected packages. "One of 'em's for you lot! Spread 'em out, and I'll find it!"
44.winText: "Sluver Leorgu"? Our pal frowns at the smudged ink. Oh! "Solver Lodge"! From... Tr Sther? Tne Secle?... The Setter?

45.title: A Hasty Retreat
45.introText: Suddenly, a siren blares. A blizzard is coming! Our pal rushes out, clutching the parcel. They have to get back up the mountain and warn the Mentor!
45.winText: There's so much ice! Our hero worries they've started going in circles, but the Lodge finally appears up ahead.

46.title: Mentor: Missing
46.introText: The Mentor is still in the caves! Our hero drops off the bookshop packet and thinks. The caves are by a frozen path, so... head towards the cold?
46.winText: Our hero's eye is streaming by the time the cave mouth comes into view. It's a relief to be out of the biting wind.

47.title: Anyone In Here?
47.introText: The cave interior is swathed in darkness. Our hero takes a nervous breath, then shuffles forward, feeling their way into the space.
47.winText: Our pal traces a wall with their fingers, moving deeper with only a few stubbed toes and awkward stumbles.

48.title: In The Mosaic Caves
48.introText: As our friend's eye adjusts to the darkness, they can make out a faint glow to one side. Drawing closer, they find a lantern illuminating a mosaic...
48.winText: The tiles are set into the cave wall itself. This place clearly meant a lot to the artist. Maybe they lived in here?

49.title: Light Trails
49.introText: There's another lantern further in... and another. The Mentor must have been working here. Our hero plunges onward, trying to catch up!
49.winText: Some mosaics show Solvers; others feature that menacing shape from the photo. Were they friends? Enemies?

50.title: The Yowls Get Closer
50.introText: "RAAAAAAGH!" A yowl so loud and so close seems to shake the entire mountain. Oh no! The Mentor! Our pal must find them before the shape does!
50.winText: Our hero spots the Mentor in another cave, but the shape is beside her, looming and opening its maw...

51.title: Yowls Can Be Deceiving
51.introText: The poor Mentor! Our pal can hardly bear to watch. It's so- Wait, are these two bickering?! Over a MOSAIC?! Our friend looks for a way to reach them...
51.winText: As our pal squeezes past stalagmites and stalagnates, the shape comes into focus...

52.title: BLIZZARD!
52.introText: It's a YETI! But there's no time to marvel. Instead, our hero shouts into the cave, trying to be heard above the yelling and yowling - BLIZZARD!!!
52.winText: An absolute cacophony fills the echoey space. Mentor and yeti finally look round: "Did you say blizzard?!"

53.title: They're Coming Down!
53.introText: All that noise sent vibrations through the stone, and stalactites start to smash down. Our pal sprints forward, dodging falling icicles of rock.
53.winText: Our hero safely reaches Mentor and yeti, but the blizzard will cause more rockfall - it's too dangerous to stay.

54.title: Let's Get Out Of Here
54.introText: The Mentor is frantically tracing the mosaic, but there's NO TIME! Our pal pulls the Mentor away, looking for a safe route out.
54.winText: The yeti stays close. It clutches a tile bag and a little grouting trowel. Is this who makes the mosaics?

55.title: Freezy Breezy
55.introText: The trio stop at a blocked passage. Where now? Our hero shivers in a cold draught, then claps excitedly. It must be coming from the cave entrance!
55.winText: Peering out of the cave, the world is a flurry of white flakes. No lodge, no path, just snow whirling past.

56.title: The Yeti Express
56.introText: The yeti snorts then steps forward, scooping the Mentor and our hero up as it strides into the howling wind, looking for signs of the Lodge.
56.winText: CRUNCH! The yeti barrels through the door of the Lodge, leaving a yeti-shaped hole and lots of splinters in its wake.

57.title: Repairing A Repair
57.introText: The Mentor is freezing! The yeti hunkers down to light the kitchen fire while our pal starts to repair the hole in the door. That'll keep the warmth in!
57.winText: As the Mentor thaws, she drops the mosaic tracing from the cave. It's wet and creased, so our pal spreads it out to dry.

58.title: Nibbled Again
58.introText:
A goat watches our hero get mugs for cocoa. A goat with a familiar package. A familiar 

newly-nibbled

 package with yellowing paper sticking out...
58.winText: The puzzle was tucked into a blank notebook. No clues there, but the wrapping has a curious spiral signature.

59.title: Mosaic Messaging
59.introText: The yeti points at the spiral signature and makes a rumbly noise, but our pal is baffled. The yeti reaches for its tile bag. An image will help.
59.winText: It's a mosaic of the Founders. All eight of them! The yeti points at the spiral signature, then taps the eighth Founder.

60.title: Mugs And Mallows
60.introText: Did the Eighth Founder send all these notes? Why?! Our pal sits at the table, idly placing marshmallows in their cocoa as they ponder the question.
60.winText: The Mentor's now-dry tracing sits nearby. It's more of a grid than a mosaic. Kinda like the letter grid in this tabletop...

61.title: The Secret Message
61.introText: Our hero grabs the tracing. It IS a letter grid! There's even a question at the top! Something round here MUST show our pal how to answer it.
61.winText: The Thinky Times? Our hero re-reads the message, eye wide. That's the newspaper Mouse is working for!
